text:
zoe: quick thread  planning an ISV onramp for LangChain/LlamaIndex + our gateway + orchestration flow. Key asks: marketplace stub, HW perf artifacts, SI installer, and a short dry-run checklist. want to keep it lightweight.

cale: i can take the marketplace stub + listing copy. will need screenshots and a 15s demo gif. who owns perf numbers?

anya: ops can own perf artifacts. we'll run T4/A10/RTX6000 sweeps, fp16 vs int8, and generate a simple p50/p95 table. will also upload annotated flamegraphs for the fallback path.

pratik: integrations note  need a small connector shim for LlamaIndex loaders and a LangChain agent example that shows tool-calls through the gateway. i'll draft a minimal notebook. sample snippet to include in docs:

```python
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RWD_DEMO'))
# LlamaIndex loader via gateway
docs = client.call_connector('llamaindex', { 'source': 's3://partner-demo/docs' })
```

cale: perfect. i'll include that in marketplace guide. also, can we standardize demo creds? last time it was ad-hoc tokens.

anya: yes — per-partner short-lived JWTs via temp-creds; default TTL 72h, scope: [generate, embeddings], optional IP allowlist. will add rotation script and revoke steps.

zoe: legal wants an asset attestation + embargo window for joint announce. hardware partners often require a 5-business-day review on co-branded collateral. flagging timeline risk.

marketing-bot: Please attach draft copy to DRIVE: https://drive.redwood.com/partners/isl-onramp-drafts and request logo from partner.

cale: note on quotas  suggest demo quota 80k tokens with billing disabled and a demo billing flag to prevent accidental charges. also add deterministic prompt pack for regression checks.

pratik: failover rules for playbook: route_by: [latency, cost], fallback_order: [redwood-xxl-int8, redwood-xl-int8]; sample routing snippet in YAML in the playbook.

anya: ops will snapshot dataset to s3://redwood-partner-demos/isl-onramp/v1 and attach the prompt pack. i'll also upload perf artifacts to s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/isl/ with a README summarizing numbers.

zoe: integrations-bot create a ticket and assign owners (marketplace, ops, integrations, legal). also schedule a 30m dry-run with partner next Thurs.

integrations-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-6142 - "ISV onramp: LangChain/LlamaIndex + gateway + orchestration" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-6142

cale: timeline proposal: first drafts by EOD Tue, dry-run Thurs AM, partner review Fri. if HW partner review >5 business days we push announce week out.

pratik: i'll scaffold the LangChain notebook + Terraform starter for gateway + helm chart and PR to tools/partner-starters by EOD Tue.

anya: perf sweep scheduled for tonight; will upload artifacts and a short one-pager that legal can cite.

zoe: action items recap: cale (marketplace copy + demo gif), anya (perf artifacts + dataset snapshot + token rotation script with revoke), pratik (notebook + starter repo + routing examples), zoe (coordinate legal + dry-run invite). try to close drafts Tue EOD. :thumbsup: 

cale: ack, will post to DRIVE and link PARTNER-6142 by 5pm.

anya: noted, perf artifacts live by 9am tomorrow.

pratik: will PR starter repo + notebook by 6pm Tue.

zoe: thanks team  i'll update PARTNER-6142 with this thread and send calendar invite for dry-run. :rocket:
